items.note: Checking this would mean finding runtime context or instruction text (project context, guidance entries, operation notes) copied into the changed files or the change's artifacts (proposal, design, specs, tasks). The engine has no kind that compares written text against the runtime context it was given. no_template_residue needs fixed patterns, and the workflow gives none here. Deciding whether a passage counts as copied guidance also needs judgement.

sources.quote: - Do not copy runtime context or operation guidance into implementation files or planning artifacts
